startup: A zero document pointer and length defer publication. The event buffer must still validate.
hydrate: After durable effects confirmation, invoke mixer_guest_ui_hydrate_v1() -> i32 once. It must return zero and leave the document absent.
read: Before the first user event, only one storage.keyValue.v1 get may enter the existing signed capability path. The guest publishes a first validated document in the completion turn under the original startup cutoff.
compatibility: Existing nonempty startup documents keep ordinary Guest UI V1 behavior.
